$comment: Copy to config/config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. npm run build injects it into each workflow's Config node. Secrets do NOT go here: they live in n8n credentials.

owner.name: Your Name
owner.context: One or two sentences the models should know, e.g. current role and that an active job search is under way.
owner.tone: Warm, direct, short. No filler. Sign off with first name only.

notion.$comment: database_id is what the n8n Notion node needs; data_source_id (collection) is what the Notion connector queries. today_page_id: the one page WF3 rewrites every morning with the day's to-dos (docs/SETUP.md).

filters.$comment: exclude_* lists are the privacy list: never sent to any model. exclude_chats accepts Telegram numeric IDs, @usernames, or "name:<display name>" (the only way to match senders who hide their account when forwarding).
linkedin_job_alert_subject_patterns: jobs? you may be interested in

gmail.$comment: Label IDs from Gmail (Label_N), not names; the trigger query must exclude the processed label.
